The clean campaign rs-a874c2ae still stops at the hypothesis input checkpoint by design; the human-checkpoint branch was exercised on the released rs-f7edf967.

The released rs-f7edf967 had a terminal cycle K-0001 (decision stop), so the first loop check returned cycle_stop. A post-release revision cycle K-0002 (decision continue) was recorded after a real source/manuscript revision; the loop then paused at human_approval. This documents a real workflow step, not an automatic bypass: the approval itself was supplied by YG in the host conversation.

The human approval P-0002 is bound to audit A-0003 / subject 3a1cd91a…; the prior P-0001 remains in history as stale. No approval was created by a model and no resume was attempted before the person answered.

A post-approval re-audit A-0004 produced the same subject hash and still reports historical P-0001 as a major approval_stale even though P-0002 is fresh. This is a non-blocking audit-history false positive (release stays 12/12); it is a candidate follow-up fix, not a reason to invalidate the approval.
